title.description:
Optional title rendered as a `

`. Rendered as a paragraph rather than a heading element so the callout does not inject an entry into the document outline. If a callout genuinely participates in the outline (e.g. it titles a standalone section), wrap it in a `

` with its own heading rather than promoting this prop to ``. When supplied and no `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is passed on rest props, the title also becomes the `aria-label` of the root element so the landmark or note has an accessible name.

variant.description: Visual + semantic variant. Default `'neutral'`, a quiet note of an icon and muted text with no tint; the status variants are tinted, so keep them for a warning or a blocking condition.

semantic.description: Root semantics. Default `'aside'`; use `'note'` for static note semantics without a complementary landmark.

class.description:
Extra classes appended to the root element. Pass via the explicit
`class` prop — it is excluded from rest-prop spread, so writing
`class="x"` inside spread attributes will not reach the root.

unsupportedProps.name: action
unsupportedProps.description:
Optional action rendered under the message, usually one `Link` or `Button`, such as "Open
attempt 5". Several actions sit in a row that wraps, and a button label never wraps. It is
interactive content, so it is the one part of a callout a person can act on; the callout
itself stays static.

unsupportedProps.name: icon
unsupportedProps.description:
Optional decorative icon rendered inside an `aria-hidden` wrapper.

The icon is a second visual channel alongside variant color — it
helps satisfy WCAG 1.4.1 (Use of Color) by ensuring the variant is
conveyed by more than color alone. The accessible meaning still
lives in `title` and/or `children`; the icon must not be the only
carrier of information.
